# the x86-64 register families masc's register file is derived from, written by masc from the sources below
#
# sources, read as published:
#   Intel SDM 325462-093US (September 2026)
#     Vol. 1 3.4.1.1: in 64-bit mode a 32-bit write is zero-extended to the 64-bit register and an 8 or 16-bit write leaves the rest. so
#       gpr32 zeroes through gpr64 and the rest keep
#     Vol. 1 3.4.2, 3.4.3, 3.4.3.4, 3.5: the segment registers, the flags and their bit positions, rflags, the instruction pointer
#     Vol. 1 8.1.2, 8.1.3, 8.1.5, 10.2.3: the x87 data registers R0 to R7, 80 bits each, st(i) named relative to the stack top so
#       it may be any of them, the status and control words, mxcsr
#     Vol. 1 9.2.2, 9.6.2: mm0 to mm7 are bits 63:0 of R0 to R7, and a write of an mmx register sets bits 79:64 of its own x87
#       register to ones and keeps the others
#     Vol. 1 14.8, 15.1.1 to 15.1.3: a legacy sse write keeps bits above 127, a vex.128 write zeroes the rest of the register, the zmm,
#       ymm and xmm views, the opmask registers at MAX_KL of 64 bits
#     Vol. 2B MOVDDUP: a vex.128 or evex.128 write zeroes bits MAXVL-1:128 and a vex.256 or evex.256 write bits MAXVL-1:256. xmm16 to
#       xmm31 are written by evex only and ymm by vex or evex only, so those zero and xmm0 to xmm15, written by a legacy write as well,
#       keep and the encoding states the zeroing
#     Vol. 1 19.1: the tile registers, 16 rows of 64 bytes at most, and tilecfg
#     Vol. 2A Table 3-1 and Vol. 2 Table B-8: the hardware numbers of the general and segment registers
#     Vol. 2B MOV to and from the control and debug registers: cr0 to cr7 and cr8, dr0 to dr7
#   Intel APX Architecture Specification 355828-009US (revision 9.0)
#     3.1.2.2 and 3.1.2.3.1: r16 to r31, and a new data destination or zu form zeroing the rest of an 8 or 16-bit write, which the
#       operand states
#   x86-64 psABI e1ce098331da5dbd66e1ffc74162380bcc213236 (master): x86-64-ABI/low-level-sys-info.tex, "DWARF Register Number Mapping".
#     the dwarf numbers. the return address column 16 is not a register, ymm and zmm are not numbered, and fs.base, gs.base, tr and ldtr
#     have no row (masc-18, #279)
#   CodeViewRegisters.def: llvm-project db9b595ae3b30d67bd4068f80c651f97eb4dea2d, llvm/include/llvm/DebugInfo/CodeView/
#     CodeViewRegisters.def, the CV_REGISTERS_X86 block, which is cvconst.h's CV_*. the codeview numbers. it has none for tmm, tilecfg,
#     rflags, rip, cr5 to cr8 and the flag bits (#278)
#   llvm-mc 23.1.1 and clang 23.1.1, as checks: `.cfi_offset` of each register read back from .eh_frame gives its dwarf number, for all but
#     tmm, mxcsr, fcw, fsw and tilecfg, which llvm does not number, and clang -gcodeview writes xmm0, edx and r8d as 154, 19 and 360
#
# lines, one record each, fields separated by blanks:
#   scale <name> <unit> <max>
#     a quantity of `unit` bits times a power of two to `max`
#   fix <scale> <extension> <multiplier>
#     the multiplier the extension fixes for the scale
#   class <name> <kind> <width> <count> <first> <names> <bank> <pieces> <offset> <places> <extend> <reach> <flags> <requires>
#     width:    bits, or a scale name for one unit of it per multiplier
#     count:    the hardware numbers the class spans
#     first:    the number of the first name
#     names:    a comma list from `first` on, each a name, a pattern with a range as `r%d:8-15` (the number in place of `%`, which must be
#               the next numbers), or a dash for a number without a register
#     bank:     `new` for storage of its own, `shared` for one bank every register of the class shares, `with:<class>` for the bank
#               of that class's first register, or `of:<class>@<delta>` for the bank of that class's register numbered delta past this
#               one, a class defined earlier with banks of its own (`with` may name a shared class as well)
#     pieces:   `-`, or `<stride>x<count>` in bits for a register of count pieces
#     offset:   `-`, bits, `number` for the register's number in bits, or `number*<bits>` for its number times bits
#     places:   `-` for a register at one place, or `<step>x<count>` in bits for a register that may be any of count places, each
#               step bits past the last, none of which a static fact chooses
#     reach:    `bank` when a write's extension reaches the whole bank past the register, or `<offset>+<width>` in bits for the one
#               part of it, past the register's first bit at its place, it reaches. a zeroes or ones class that reaches only a part
#               states it, or its write kills the whole bank
#     extend, flags and requires: a value, or a comma list of `range:value` entries by register number and a last plain value. an extend
#               is keep, zeroes or ones. flags are `-` or zero, stack or pc. requires is `-`, or extensions of which one alternative
#               must be held, each alternative the extensions joined by `&` and the alternatives by `|`, as named in x86's extension ids
#   number <dwarf|codeview> <first> <names>
#     the names, in the form of a class's, numbered consecutively from first in that format
#
# a register of one width is a row of its own class, as the class holds one width, and the views of one physical register share its
# bank: al, ax, eax and rax are rows of one bank, ah is that bank at bit 8, and xmm0, ymm0 and zmm0 are rows of another. the legacy high
# bytes are a class of their own, as they and spl, bpl, sil and dil share the numbers 4 to 7 (Vol. 1 3.4.1.1). the x87 registers share
# one bank, R0 to R7 128 bits apart. st(i) may be any of the eight (Vol. 1 8.1.2), so every st row overlaps every mm row and every other
# st row and lies within none, and mm<n> is bits 0 to 63 of R<n>, whose write sets bits 64 to 79 of R<n> only (Vol. 1 9.6.2)

scale xlen 32 2
fix xlen x86-64 2

class gpr64   general   64   32 0 rax,rcx,rdx,rbx,rsp,rbp,rsi,rdi,r%:8-31  new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  4:stack,- 0-15:x86-64,16-31:apx_f
class gpr32   general   32   32 0 eax,ecx,edx,ebx,esp,ebp,esi,edi,r%d:8-31 of:gpr64@0  -      -          -     zeroes                 bank  -         0-7:-,8-15:x86-64,16-31:apx_f
class gpr16   general   16   32 0 ax,cx,dx,bx,sp,bp,si,di,r%w:8-31         of:gpr64@0  -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         0-7:-,8-15:x86-64,16-31:apx_f
class gpr8    general   8    32 0 al,cl,dl,bl,spl,bpl,sil,dil,r%b:8-31     of:gpr64@0  -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         0-3:-,4-15:x86-64,16-31:apx_f
class gpr8h   general   8    8  4 ah,ch,dh,bh                              of:gpr64@-4 -      8          -     keep                   bank  -         -
class xmm     vector    128  32 0 xmm%:0-31                                new         -      -          -     0-15:keep,16-31:zeroes bank  -         0-7:sse,8-15:sse&x86-64,16-31:avx512f&x86-64
class ymm     vector    256  32 0 ymm%:0-31                                of:xmm@0    -      -          -     zeroes                 bank  -         0-7:avx,8-15:avx&x86-64,16-31:avx512f&x86-64
class zmm     vector    512  32 0 zmm%:0-31                                of:xmm@0    -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         0-7:avx512f,8-31:avx512f&x86-64
class k       predicate 64   8  0 k%:0-7                                   new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         avx512f
class st      float     80   8  0 st%:0-7                                  shared      -      -          128x8 keep                   bank  -         x87
class mm      vector    64   8  0 mm%:0-7                                  with:st     -      number*128 -     ones                   64+16 -         mmx
class tmm     tile      512  8  0 tmm%:0-7                                 new         512x16 -          -     keep                   bank  -         amx_tile&x86-64
class sreg    system    16   6  0 es,cs,ss,ds,fs,gs                        new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         -
class creg    system    xlen 9  0 cr%:0-8                                  new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         8:x86-64,-
class dreg    system    xlen 8  0 dr%:0-7                                  new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         -
class rflags  flags     xlen 1  0 rflags                                   new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         -
class flag flags 1 22 0 rflags.cf,-,rflags.pf,-,rflags.af,-,rflags.zf,rflags.sf,rflags.tf,rflags.if,rflags.df,rflags.of,-,-,rflags.nt,-,rflags.rf,rflags.vm,rflags.ac,rflags.vif,rflags.vip,rflags.id with:rflags - number - keep bank - -
class rip     system    xlen 1  0 rip                                      new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  pc        -
class x87ctl  system    16   2  0 fcw,fsw                                  new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         x87
class mxcsr   system    32   1  0 mxcsr                                    new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         sse
class tilecfg system    512  1  0 tilecfg                                  new         -      -          -     keep                   bank  -         amx_tile&x86-64

number dwarf 0 rax rdx rcx rbx rsi rdi rbp rsp r%:8-15
number dwarf 17 xmm%:0-15
number dwarf 33 st%:0-7 mm%:0-7
number dwarf 49 rflags es cs ss ds fs gs
number dwarf 64 mxcsr fcw fsw xmm%:16-31
number dwarf 118 k%:0-7
number dwarf 130 r%:16-31 tmm%:0-7 tilecfg

number codeview 1 al cl dl bl ah ch dh bh ax cx dx bx sp bp si di eax ecx edx ebx esp ebp esi edi
number codeview 25 es cs ss ds fs gs
number codeview 80 cr0 cr1 cr2 cr3 cr4
number codeview 90 dr%:0-7
number codeview 128 st%:0-7
number codeview 136 fcw fsw
number codeview 146 mm%:0-7
number codeview 154 xmm%:0-7
number codeview 211 mxcsr
number codeview 252 xmm%:8-15
number codeview 324 sil dil bpl spl
number codeview 328 rax rbx rcx rdx rsi rdi rbp rsp r%:8-15 r%b:8-15 r%w:8-15 r%d:8-15
number codeview 368 ymm%:0-15
number codeview 694 xmm%:16-31 ymm%:16-31 zmm%:0-31 k%:0-7
number codeview 856 r%:16-31 r%b:16-31 r%w:16-31 r%d:16-31
